'''Borers''' were a type of mining tool used during the reign of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. The [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and his co-[[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] kept a borer along with various other such tools in one of the cargo bays of their ship, the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']].
